$comment: This file is generated from Python source. Do not edit it manually; run python scripts/generate_schemas.py.

defaultProvider.description: Provider of the default model. A role's own settings.json may hold its own pair, which wins for that role.

defaultModel.description: Default model id, with defaultProvider. A role's own settings.json may hold its own pair, which wins for that role.

defaultThinkingLevel.description: Thinking level a new session starts at. A role's own settings.json may hold its own, which wins for that role.

modelThinkingLevels.description: Per-model default thinking level overrides keyed by "provider/modelId".

sessionShareDestination.description: Destination used by /share. "auto" uses Radius when authenticated and otherwise creates a GitHub gist.

modelOverrides.description: Per-model overrides keyed by exact "provider/modelId" strings.

reserveTokens.description: Tokens reserved for the prompt and LLM response.

skipPrompt.description: When true, skips the "Summarize branch?" prompt and defaults to no summary.

baseDelayMs.description: Exponential backoff base delay in milliseconds: 2s, 4s, 8s.

timeoutMs.description: SDK or provider request timeout in milliseconds.

showCacheMissNotices.description: Show cache cost and provider recovery notices.

externalEditor.description: Command for Ctrl+G external editor; takes precedence over VISUAL and EDITOR.

shellPath.description: Custom shell path, for example for Cygwin on Windows, with support for leading ~ expansion.

quietStartup.description: When true, hide all startup output. When "header", keep only the startup header.

shellCommandPrefix.description: Prefix prepended to every bash command, for example to enable shell aliases.

collapseChangelog.description: Kept for compatibility; MISAKA ships no changelog, so this has no effect.

enableInstallTelemetry.description: Name this client "misaka" to aggregator gateways such as OpenRouter, NVIDIA and Cloudflare; nothing else is sent.

extensions.description: Local extension file paths or directories, and +builtin:<name> or -builtin:<name> entries that turn a built-in extension on or off.

deviceId.description: Stable installation UUID, generated when authentication first needs it. Global only.

external_dirs.description: More folders of skills to read; ~/.agents/skills is always read when it exists.

disabled.description: Skill names to hide from every role.

platform_disabled.description: Skill names to hide on one surface, keyed by its name.

skills.description: MISAKA's skill index: more skill folders, and skills to hide. A list of skill paths is not read here.

prompts.description: Local prompt template file paths or directories.

themes.description: Local theme file paths or directories.

showImages.description: Show images when the terminal supports them.

imageWidthCells.description: Preferred inline image width in terminal cells.

clearOnShrink.description: Clear empty rows when content shrinks.

autoResize.description: Resize images to 2000x2000 maximum for better model compatibility.

blockImages.description: When true, prevents all images from being sent to LLM providers.

enabledModels.description: Model patterns for cycling, in the same format as the --models CLI flag.

defaultTools.description: Initial tool selection. Plain names replace the inherited selection; +name and -name entries add or remove tools.

doubleEscapeAction.description: Action for double-escape with an empty editor.

thinkingBudgets.description: Custom token budgets for thinking levels.

editorPaddingX.description: Horizontal padding for the input editor.

autocompleteMaxVisible.description: Maximum visible items in the autocomplete dropdown.

showHardwareCursor.description: Use the terminal cursor instead of MISAKA's drawn cursor.

mode.description: How codemode presents tools. "on" keeps direct tools declared and annotates tools callable from scripts; codemode lists only tools without direct exposure. "only" lists every script-callable tool in codemode and does not declare active direct tools.

inlineBudget.description: Estimated tokens available for inline codemode tool declarations.

sessionDir.description: Custom session storage directory, in the same format as the --session-dir CLI flag.

httpProxy.description: Proxy URL applied as HTTP_PROXY and HTTPS_PROXY for MISAKA-managed HTTP clients.

httpIdleTimeoutMs.description: HTTP header or body idle timeout in milliseconds; 0 or "disabled" disables it.

cacheWarming.description: Cache-warming profile. "idle" also warms between agent runs. Global only because each refresh costs money.

websocketConnectTimeoutMs.description: WebSocket connect or open handshake timeout in milliseconds; 0 or "disabled" disables it.

web.description: Web search and fetch backends, their tiers, caches and blocklists; `misaka web` writes it. A role's own settings.json may hold its own web section, laid over this one.

moa.description: Mixture-of-Agents presets (presets, default_preset), published as models of the moa provider.

allies.description: Other vendors' agents that can take cards, by name: a preset name, or an entry with command, env and description.

agents.description: Sub-agent types, by name: description, prompt, and the other fields of an agent definition file.

pluginOptions.description: Options for each plugin's sub-agents, by plugin name.

allow.description: Tool rules that are allowed without asking, such as "Bash(git status)".

ask.description: Tool rules that always ask first.

deny.description: Tool rules that are refused; "Agent(type)" hides that sub-agent type.

additionalDirectories.description: More folders sub-agents may work in, besides the workspace.

writeDirectories.description: Absolute folders that write or edit (the keys) may change outside the workspace.

permissions.description: Permission rules for sub-agents and their hooks.

hooks.description: Sub-agent hooks, by event: matchers, each with the hooks it runs.

sparsePaths.description: Check out only these repository paths.

symlinkDirectories.description: Repository folders linked into the worktree instead of copied (trusted projects only).

worktree.description: How the git worktree of a sub-agent started with isolation "worktree" is made.

cleanupPeriodDays.description: Days after which a sub-agent worktree that is no longer used is removed. Default: 30.

autoMemoryEnabled.description: Let sub-agents keep memory between tasks. Default: true.

ocr_langs.description: Languages for reading scanned PDFs, joined with "+". Default: eng+chi_sim+jpn.

required_wait.description: Seconds a sub-agent waits for an MCP server its definition requires. Default: 30.

mcp.description: MCP servers, as sub-agents wait for them. The servers themselves are in each role's mcp.json.

max_concurrent_per_sister.description: Cards one Sister runs at once. Default: the machine limit.

max_concurrent_sisters.description: Cards running at once on this machine. Default: free memory / 256 MiB, between 4 and 12.

network.description: How many Sister cards run at once.

prefix.description: The panel's prefix key, "ctrl+" and a letter. Default: ctrl+b.

beast_at.description: Share of the token cap at which a card is told to wrap up. Default: 0.85.

plan_approval.description: Every research plan waits for your go-ahead. Default: true.

token_cap.description: Token budget of one research run, its cards and sub-agents included; 0 is no cap.

agent_list_in_messages.description: List the available sub-agent types in messages.

auto_background_tasks.description: Move a foreground sub-agent to the background after two minutes.

auto_memory.description: Let sub-agents keep memory between tasks.

background_tasks.description: Allow sub-agents to run in the background.

coordinator_mode.description: Coordinator mode: a session does not fork sub-agents from its own conversation.

effort_level.description: "auto", "low", "medium", "high", "xhigh" or "max", for models that take an effort setting.

inherit_process_group.description: Run sub-agents in the session's own process group instead of a new one.

managed_agents_dir.description: A folder of sub-agent definitions that take precedence over all others.

max_concurrent.description: Sub-agents one session runs at once. Default: 20.

memory_home.description: Where sub-agent memory is kept. Default: state/agent-memory.

memory_snapshot.description: In a trusted project, start a sub-agent's memory from the project's memory snapshot.

simple.description: Simple mode: sub-agents keep no memory.

small_fast_model.description: The model a sub-agent type's hooks use when they name none.

task_max_output.description: Characters from the end of a background task's output that the output tool shows.

verification_agent.description: Offer the built-in verification sub-agent type.

esc_timeout_ms.description: How long Esc waits to see whether it starts an Alt+key, in milliseconds.

model.description: One vision model (provider/model) for the whole home, which reads images for models that cannot see.

vision.description: Reading images for models that cannot see.

lcm.description: The long-conversation context engine (bundled extension): context_threshold is the share of the context window at which a session compacts (default 0.35). Other behaviour is set with LCM_* variables.

auxiliary.description: Models for auxiliary tasks of the bundled extensions, by task: compression (provider, model) writes the conversation summaries; the default is the session's own model.

compression.description: Conversation compression, as the long-conversation context engine reads it: threshold is the share of the context window at which a session compacts when lcm.context_threshold is not set; enabled false ignores it.
